question:

Restrained
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Controlled.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Restrained" means kept under control; not displaying strong emotion. Its closest synonym among the options is "controlled". (संयमित)

◦ Example: Despite the provocation, the diplomat remained restrained (controlled) and chose his words very carefully.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1 "Occasional" means occurring at irregular intervals; scattered or isolated — different in sense from "restrained".

• Option 3 "Relocation" means movement of people or animals from one place to settle in another — different in sense from "restrained".

• Option 4 "Revere" means regard with great respect or reverence — different in sense from "restrained".

 

NOTE

• Synonym of restrained: controlled. Antonyms: unrestrained, excessive, uncontrolled.
